title: Detect vessels in Sentinel-1 SAR using two-parameter CFAR on VH band
description: Detect vessels using a two-parameter CFAR algorithm on the VH polarization band. Use a ring window with an inner window of 200×200 pixels and an outer window of 600×600 pixels. CFAR evaluates local background mean and standard deviation and flags anomalies above a time-dependent threshold. The paper reports different calibrated thresholds across time intervals and by satellite (S1A vs S1B) to maintain consistent detection of smaller vessels.

inputs.sar_scenes: Pre-processed SAR scenes with VH available
inputs.thresholds: Calibrated thresholds by time interval and satellite

outputs.cfar_detections: Candidate vessel detections (bright anomalies) with locations and metadata
